lines.english: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
lines.emitted_text: tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsel'i henakwon tsohiyuhsv tsahstelv khilakwono iyvtv kwakowhahthvhti nulhsthane'i ale uhstawatvhse tsihsa a'ihsv'i
